projectState.summary: Byte 9a is implemented and ready for Claude review. The thought protocol validators now reject scaleDegree values outside the active scale, pitches whose pitch class is outside the active scale, pitch/scaleDegree disagreement, and PlayerThoughtIntent musicalIdea.durationBeats values beyond the request maxDurationBeats. sourceStartBeat is documented as provenance/debug while intent.target owns placement. The smoke test includes invalid model-like examples proving these failures. No Ollama, persistence, producer, transport, taste, session, lookahead, or audio scheduling changes were added.
